title: Inbox request ordering, dialog focus, keyboard controls and floating menus

categories.prompt: Open thread A, switch to B, then resolve B before the delayed A response. Change list filters and deliver the newer result first.
Unmount Inbox while initialization is awaiting settings, then resolve the settings request. Also remount while old requests are pending.
Open a dialog, then a nested dialog, image lightbox or access warning. Cycle Tab and Shift+Tab, then press Escape.
Use Enter or Space to activate the import selector, registry tag and scheduled-job expander. Navigate the Calm access menu with arrows, including its unavailable current profile.
Open artifact menus near the bottom-right edge in a short window, dispatch 40 resize events together, then close the menu and repeat the events.

notes: This manifest links to executable Vitest regressions and the isolated Electron UI harness. The harness uses fixture APIs and a disposable profile with a Vite server bound to 127.0.0.1; it never connects a real mailbox. These JSON assertions are traceability metadata, not independently graded by run_eval_suite.cjs.
